content:
maria-marketing: Quick sync — targeting public announce for v2 embeddings + adaptive batching on Tue 09:00 PT. Need final changelog URL, docs links, and the canary rollout window. Also want to confirm webinar promo timing.

jon-eng: ACK. I can post the changelog once QA signs off (EOD Mon). Will ping when it's upstream. Any constraints on canary length?

maria-marketing: Prefer a 3-hour canary with 5% traffic then open to 50% if no regressions. We want the public post + docs live at canary start.

alex-ops: 3-hour canary is fine. Ops can schedule traffic shift at 09:00, 12:00, 12:30 as needed. Need the release tag and model variant id so automation can route.

jon-eng: Release tag will be `release/v2-emb-2026-03`. Model variant id: `emb-v2-opt`. I'll update the canary config in the release pipeline.

deploy-bot: [automated] canary job created: job_id=canary-179999-01, window=180m, initial_percent=5, fallback=emb-v1-stable.

maria-marketing: Perfect — Sophie, can you confirm docs URL (getting us a quick how-to + changelog reference) and advise on hero screenshots for the blog?

sophie-docs: Draft is at https://docs.redwood.ai/embeddings/v2/draft — will finish examples + screenshot by Mon 17:00 PT. Changelog anchor will be https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog#v2-embeddings.

ben-growth: For inbound routing, we want a UTM'd blog link and a /signup landing with demo CTA live at canary start. Can product-marketing get the landing HTML ready? I can wire the routing rules in HubSpot.

maria-marketing: Yep, landing url will be https://redwood.ai/embeddings-v2?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=v2_launch. Ben, can you confirm HubSpot flow will tag leads with `campaign=v2_launch` and route enterprise leads to AE queue?

ben-growth: Will do. Enterprise threshold = monthly spend estimate > $10k or setup request checked. Routing rule created and tested in staging.

jon-eng: One last ask from eng — we need the announcement copy to call out model compatibility and the recommended quantization profile. Suggest short bullet: "Compatible with emb-v1 adapters; recommended quantization: q4_0 for latency-sensitive workloads."

maria-marketing: Good call. I'll include that in the blog + release notes. Draft post ETA Mon 11:00 PT for review.

alex-ops: Ops checklist: confirm KMS keys pre-provisioned, telemetry dashboards for token cost and latency pinned, rollback playbook ready. I uploaded a short rollback snippet to the runbook: ```
# rollback
route traffic to emb-v1-stable
revert release tag
notify #incidents
```

maria-marketing: Thanks. Final timeline recap: Mon EOD — changelog + docs finished; Mon 11:00 — marketing draft for review; Tue 09:00 PT — canary start + blog + docs go live; Tue 12:00 PT — expand rollout if green; Webinar promo email to go out Tue 13:00 PT (after initial stability). If anything slips, call it out here. :thumbsup:

jon-eng: We'll aim for that. I'll post the final changelog link here once uploaded.

sophie-docs: Docs link will be the changelog anchor above. I'll paste final screenshot links here once uploaded to CDN.

ben-growth: HubSpot flow scheduled, email template ready, holding content for final blog CTA and time.

deploy-bot: [reminder] canary job canary-179999-01 set to start at 2026-03-31T16:00:00Z (09:00 PT).

maria-marketing: Great — thanks everyone. Ping me if any of the assets slip so we can reschedule the webinar promo. :sparkles:
